description: Safety is about recognizing and reducing risk: what safety means, home inspections and escape plans, personal and online safety, what to do in emergencies in public places, and safety as a pedestrian and passenger.
outlineNote: Excerpts were fragmentary and did not show current numbering, so no requirement outline is published yet. Topics include managing hazards, home and family safety, crime and personal safety, emergencies in public places, and transportation safety.
